newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK KATSELIS OK'S 0.51BLN DRS RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK KATSELIS OK'S 0.51BLN DRS RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: Shareholders of Greek bakery Katselis granted their approval on a proposal for a 513 million drachma rights issue at the general meeting held on Wednesday, issue advisor Telesis Capital said in a statement.
Katselis will issue 371,910 new common bearer shares with a par value of 100 drachmas.
The terms are 98 new common shares per 1,000 outstanding, either common or preferred, at 1,380 drachmas.

Katselis will use proceeds to complete its 1995-97 investment programme amounting to 1.02 billion drachmas which is subsidised at 35 percent by the Greek ministry of development, Telesis Capital said.
Katselis produced pretax earnings of 1.009 bilion drachmas in fiscal 1996, up 18.6 percent on 1995, on turnover growth of 15 percent to 7.3 billion drachmas.
A dividend per share of 120 drachmas for fiscal 1996 will be proposed to shareholders at the forthcoming annual general meeting. 1995 per share dividend was 100 drachmas.
Katselis's common shares added five drachmas to 1,800 on Wednesday on high volume of 59,220 shares.
Preferred shares were off five drachmas to 1,595, with 8,940 shares having changed hands. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
